data.narrative:
Solar Foods is a publicly traded biotech and health company founded by Pasi Vainikka and four co-founders, having raised $160M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 3 same-sector, same-stage public comparables: Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), Freenome ($1.1B), and Alto Neuroscience ($1.0B).

The peer-median method is the primary applicable triangulation approach, yielding an implied valuation of $1.1B based on the median across the three public biotech comparables. This method establishes a valuation range bounded by the peer minimum of $1.0B and peer maximum of $1.6B. A public-comp anchoring approach using price-to-sales multiples was not applicable, as Solar Foods' revenue is not on file and private companies rarely disclose this metric; the sector median P/S of 9.2x across three public biotech tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) cannot be reliably applied without the target's revenue figure.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $935M to $1.3B, centered on $1.1B. This single-method conclusion carries meaningful uncertainty given the limited peer set and the absence of revenue-based valuation approaches. Key sensitivities include Solar Foods' underlying revenue scale relative to peers and near-term cash burn trajectory, neither of which can be assessed from available data.
